name: bohr
description: Open-source, self-hosted deploy platform operated by an AI agent through Telegram or the web.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Protects /setup and the admin API. At least 32 random characters, for example from: openssl rand -hex 32

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Master key of the vault that encrypts stored credentials: 32 random bytes in base64 (openssl rand -base64 32). Keep a copy.

APP_URL.description: Leave empty: the instance uses the address you open /setup with.
